thread:
Ruth Calderon: Quick UX bug on very small screens (~300px). When the left rail auto-collapses the table's first column wraps and the focus outline disappears when tabbing. Happens on iPhone SE and small Android. Screenshot: https://staging.redwood.internal/ux/mini-issue.png

Mikhail Ivanov: Repro'd on Chrome emulation. Looks like the sidebar width transition + long IDs cause a mid-frame reflow. The ellipsis sometimes ends up in the wrong column.

Tess O'Neil: Accessibility: VoiceOver reads truncated cells as 'more' -> we should add aria-label with full text. Also ensure the inline copy button announces "Copied" to an aria-live region.

Mikhail Ivanov: Minimal CSS fix I'm testing: 
```css
.id-cell { min-width: 84px; max-width: clamp(72px, 30vw, 160px); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.main-area { transition: none; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .main-area { transition: width 140ms ease; } }
```
This prevents thrash during the collapse.

Tess O'Neil: Prefer toggling the transition class only during the collapse instead of disabling globally, and add visually-hidden full text for screen readers. For mobile taps, long-press shows 'Copy ID'.

Ruth Calderon: Assigning @Mikhail for a small PR, @Tess for a11y QA. Please include visual diffs at 320px and 300px and a tiny integration test asserting the first column stays >= 72px.

QA-Bot: Kicking off visual checks for iPhone SE and narrow Android. Will report results here.

Ruth Calderon: Thanks team :sparkles:
